Ojo ,
Muchacho de barba empleado de la estación , te roba con la carga , carga de menos o directamente no te carga y te cobra ; me di cuenta porque la computadora de mi auto marcaba el mismo recorrido que antes de cargar , el tipo se apura a empezar a cargar al que sigue para borrar el surtidor , ypf mano a panamericana 6/12/22 a las 9 y 10 de
La mañana , LADRÓN ES

(Translated by Google)
Beware!
The bearded guy who works at the gas station is ripping you off. He'll underfill your tank or not fill it at all and still charge you. I realized this because my car's computer was showing the same route as before I filled up. The guy rushes to start filling up the next car to clear the pump's reading. YPF Mano on Panamericana, 6/12/22 at 9:10 AM.
He's a thief!
